structured_output.rationale: All four lines deny OA-18 exact duplicate, but the claim itself contains two 97140 lines and two 97110 lines for the same DOS with no repeat-procedure modifier. Chart note documents four distinct treatment segments (two manual-therapy bouts, two exercise bouts) totaling 76 timed minutes, so these are legitimate repeat services misread as duplicates of each other, not a resent claim.

root_cause.explanation: Lines 1&3 (97140-GP-KX) and lines 2&4 (97110-GP-KX) repeat the same code twice on one DOS with no distinguishing modifier (e.g. 76), so the payer's duplicate edit collided the repeat lines against each other.

next_action.detail: Medicare Part B FFS: file a clerical-error reopening (CLM05-3=7 not accepted) adding modifier 76 to the second occurrence of each repeated code (lines 3 and 4) to document distinct repeat therapy sessions; do not resend as a new original.
